timing_basis: first builder launch to controller handoff record; includes user interruption and audit activity; not active execution duration
lane: one bounded builder followed by independent review
config_identity: Initial launch user config loaded (codex doctor confirmed); repair/re-review used explicit --ignore-user-config model/reasoning/approval overrides. No configuration changes made.

notes: CLI aggregate token figures are reported totals, not measured input/output decomposition. Original builder finish times retained as its claims in COMPLETION.json. No speedup comparison or full-product acceptance claimed. MCP startup warnings did not change code validation results.
